title: A drowned flower makes a glowing comeback after rain
caption:
It looked drowned… then the sun came back 🌈
A tiny 3D flower gets soaked by heavy rain, buried in mud and fades into the dark — then sunlight returns and it blooms brighter than ever.
Loop it in a dark, quiet room and let the comeback glow do its thing.
Ever felt like this little flower after a long stormy week?
Save this for your next rainy day and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more tiny stories.
